reasons.plausibility: Selective recrystallization of one phase to reduce dislocation pile-ups and improve ductility is scientifically plausible given known microstructural engineering principles.
reasons.testability: Comparing annealed versus untreated samples through standard tensile testing and microstructural characterization directly tests the hypothesis and can clearly falsify it if the expected improvements are not observed.
reasons.usefulness: This targeted recrystallization approach addresses a key challenge in eutectic high-entropy alloys and, if successful, would significantly enhance mechanical properties, making it highly relevant and beneficial for researchers.
